name: demolition
description: Breaching charges: wire one to something, set a fuse, and be somewhere else when it goes. Defusing works on anybody's charge, including yours.

breach.note: Advertised on any furniture carrying the demolishable tag; the handler still self-resolves the target by name.

defuse.note: KNOWN GAP: a live charge is not a furniture row, so there is no object to hang an examine action off. It is advertised by the room line the fuse broadcasts and by `charges`.
